text:
lina: quick thought — i want to propose a 3-week evaluation cadence for the next DP cohort. shorter than our usual 6 weeks so we can iterate faster
owen: +1 for speed. what's the minimum signal we need to call success?
lina: thinking: 3 sample user flows, NPS pulse after week 2, and no >10% regression on top-10 prompts vs baseline
raj: can we be explicit about the top-10 prompts? we should lock them before invites go out — otherwise metrics drift
anya: agree with raj. also want to discuss incentives — $200 credit vs $500 stipend? affects recruitment speed
marie: from SEs: lower stipend means slower uptake but better-quality asks. $350 might be the sweet spot
lina: noted. recruitment ask: 12 seats, split 8 external DP + 4 internal partners for obs and support
owen: timeline?
lina: week 0: invite + onboarding doc. week 1: baseline run (15-min setup), week 2: guided eval, week 3: final pulse + debrief
product-bot: uploaded doc: /design/dp-cadence/4212345678-cadence-spec.md
raj: can we include a one-page checklist in that doc with acceptance gates? helps eng and SEs triage quickly
anya: sample acceptance gates draft: 
```
- onboarding < 30 mins
- key-flow success rate >= 85%
- NPS >= 7
- no functional regressions > 10% on top-10 prompts
```
marie: i'd add a qualitative gate — partner says they'd integrate in next 3 months or give explicit reasons they wouldn't
owen: question on feedback loop: do we want weekly async digests + one 60m call at end, or a mid-run checkin call too?
lina: prefer mid-run 30m + final 60m. weekly async digest (sheets + heatmap) for triage
anya: heatmap idea: show error classes across prompts, plus a small list of reproducible failures. super helpful for prioritization
raj: for obs, we should instrument these signals: prompt id, latency, token-cost, success flag, and free-text partner notes
marie: gating for launch readiness: 1) 3 green DP seats, 2) no showstopper bugs, 3) rollout plan + rollback steps documented
owen: rollout plan = staged release: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with canary metrics
lina: yes. also add fallback model variant for cost/latency spikes
anya: one last ask — recruitment messaging. i can draft a short outreach that emphasizes low-friction onboarding and $350 stipend, and a clear eval ask (3 flows + 30m debrief)
marie: ping me on the draft before sending, i'll add legal-friendly wording for data usage
raj: sounds good. who owns the prompt set curation?
lina: raj and anya will own prompt set. owen + engineering will provide telemetry hooks and an eval harness
product-bot: reminder: please add your RSVP to the doc by end of day Friday
lina: thanks all — i'll update the doc with the cadence + gates and tag people for sign-off. if no objections by EOD Friday we lock invites next monday
owen: ack
anya: ack
marie: ack
raj: ack
